__comment: OAuth2 (Ory Hydra). The shared customUI app com.palm.app.cloud-auth hosts the Koofr consent webview; it loads OAuth2.buildAuthorizeUrl(), captures ?code= from the redirect to Config.REDIRECT_URI, then calls exchangeCode which returns the stored token credentials. The primary mount is resolved lazily by the adapter (GET /mounts). Koofr provides BOTH DOCUMENTS and PHOTO.UPLOAD.
__comment2: com.palm.app.cloud-auth MUST be in write/readPermissions: createAccount runs under the customUI auth app's identity and is permission-checked against these lists.
__comment3: com.palm.service.koofr is in read+writePermissions so the service can readCredentials(accountId) for file ops and writeCredentials back after a token refresh (Koofr access tokens expire; the refresh token renews them).

capabilityProviders.__comment: The file-picker app and the account-derived QuickOffice reroute consume listFolder/downloadFile/uploadFile. Locators are absolute paths within the primary mount; the root sentinel maps to the mount root '/'.

PHOTO.UPLOAD marks the account as a photo source. The hooks of webOS 3.0.5 (implementation/onEnabled/onDelete/onCredentialsChanged on com.palm.service.photos) are gone: LuneOS has no such aggregator, and the Accounts service would call them on every create, enable and delete. A Photos app finds these accounts by capability and calls the connector service directly (listAlbums, listPhotos, upload, deletePhoto).
